changelog:
Initial release of the Design Critique skill with a new structured framework for actionable, principle-based design feedback.

- Provides prioritised critiques using UX frameworks such as Jobs-to-be-Done, Gestalt principles, and Nielsen's usability heuristics.
- Asks clarifying questions for missing context (goal, stage, primary concern, etc.) to tailor feedback.
- Offers a consistent output: strengths, prioritised issues (High/Medium/Low), heuristic and Gestalt checks, and JTBD alignment.
- Delivers clear, actionable recommendations and top 3 next steps for iteration.
- Includes quality checks and anti-patterns to ensure principle-driven, non-generic feedback.
- All supporting reference files consolidated into a single, concise documentation file.
summary: Give structured, constructive feedback on any design using UX frameworks. Use when asked to critique a design, review a UI, give feedback on a Figma file or...
